verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'Connectors' for posting from external services into channels and 'Outgoing Webhooks' for the reverse direction, suggesting some webhook-based integration exists, but no evidence describes a simple, no-registration incoming webhook URL like Slack's. Community evidence directly contradicts simplicity, stating Teams integration 'requires the full Azure/Graph API stack unlike Slack's simple webhooks,' and the only documented message-posting API (channel-post-messages) is OAuth-gated Graph API, not a bare webhook URL.
